title: The Friends at Emmaus
reflectionQuestion: Jesus was walking beside his friends even before they knew it was him. When might Jesus be close to you, even when you cannot see him?
kidSafetyNotes: NEW anchor (extra, emotional room = JESUS WALKS BESIDE US even when we don't realize it). Easter-adjacent, follows Empty Tomb. The friends start sad (grieving Jesus' death -- gentle, no detail); kept CONCRETE for the youngest (a stranger joins, opens the scriptures, hearts warm, then at supper breaks bread -> 'it's Jesus!' -> gone -> they run back full of joy). Lands on 'he was with them the whole time' (the not-alone spine, for the 6-7 end especially). longEligible=TRUE (upgraded 2026-06-20: the walk + conversation + burning hearts + recognition + run-back is a genuine journey-and-reveal arc). Will get short+full+long. 'God'/'Jesus' throughout, no Yahweh. VOICE_REVEREND_MICHAEL (pastoral -- the contemplative walk + gentle reveal).

scriptureKeyVerse.text: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.
